study_type: Simulated novice participant, not a recruited human

persona.description: Visual artist curious about sound design
persona.experience: No DAW experience or prior RILL knowledge

goal: Create a short atmospheric loop with included sounds, layer a second sound, add space, and save/export without external samples or plugins.

session.method: Isolated native desktop mouse/keyboard driver; choices based on visible screenshots only. No source, app internal state, documentation beyond required AGENTS.md, or other participant findings used.

outcome.status: Creation, layering, effects, project save and WAV export completed visually; actual listening blocked/unverified

layers.content: Six sustained notes in two three-note chords
layers.effects: R1 Spacer, Tape Echo preset with Hall Reverb enabled and Decay increased

chronological_discoveries.finding: File > New presents a clear Choose instrument starting action.
R1 Sampler Soft Pad preset changes processing parameters but still displays No sample.
R1 Mini includes a String Pad preset and an on-screen piano below the first screenful.
Right-click Edit notes is the working entry to the piano grid; double-click opens rename.
Pencil drag creates long notes and automatically extends the clip into another bar.
Loop playback over selection sets the loop boundaries around the clip.
R1 Spacer exposes both Echo and Reverb, with independently enabled sections.
A second instrument track creates its own empty pattern and can be edited by the learned context-menu path.
Export WAV offers Loop range with an exact-length explanation and confirms success by filename.

issues.title: Sampler preset names suggest usable sounds but the sampler stays empty
steps: Choose R1 Sampler and add track
Try the on-screen piano and inspect the sample area
issues.expected: A Soft Pad preset should supply an atmospheric sound, or clearly explain that an audio file is still needed.
issues.observed: Soft Pad selected, but No sample and Load sample remain. The participant abandoned the sampler for R1 Mini.
issues.recovery: Change instrument > R1 Mini > String Pad.
issues.confidence: high for visible state; no claim about audible silence because audio environment also failed

issues.title: Double-clicking a pattern opens rename; Keyboard is a typing keyboard
steps: Click Keyboard in the resulting popover
Cancel and double-click lower in the pattern
issues.expected: Open a place to compose notes; Keyboard appears to mean a musical keyboard in this context.
issues.observed: Double-click opened rename, including a typing keyboard. Repeating lower in the clip still opened rename. Only right-click Edit notes revealed the piano grid.
issues.recovery: Found Edit notes in context menu after several exploratory actions; successfully reused it for the second layer.

issues.title: Instrument replacement leaves the old instrument name on the track and dialog title
issues.expected: Easy confirmation that the sound source is now R1 Mini.
issues.observed: Panel body says R1 Mini while title says Instrument of R1 Sampler; arranger track still says R1 Sampler.
issues.recovery: Manually renamed track Mist Pad; Mixer later displays MIDI · R1 Mini.
issues.confidence: high for labels; may be intentional track-name persistence

issues.title: Effects dialog changed vertical position between first screenshot and interaction
steps: Click the Insert position from the visible screenshot
issues.observed: Assistant opened. On returning, the Effects dialog was lower and its AI button occupied approximately the previous Insert location.
issues.recovery: Return and click Insert at its new position; later captures taken after a separate tool roundtrip.
issues.confidence: low-to-medium; screenshot timing and layout settling may exaggerate this in simulated coordinate interaction; review recording before treating as product defect

environment_observations.title: Audio output failed or disconnected
environment_observations.impact: Could not audition or judge atmosphere, levels, effect quality or loop transition by listening.
steps: Observed failure banner after sampler exploration
Opened Audio setup, selected Rill lab paced output, Apply, Start, Play
environment_observations.observed: Transport advanced briefly to 0:00.44 before failure returned. Later note drawing also showed reconnect-before-audition warning.
environment_observations.attribution: Environment-confounded; coordinator notified. Do not classify as established RILL defect.

environment_observations.title: Initial Load sample action produced no native chooser
environment_observations.observed: Two screenshots showed no dialog after Load sample. Coordinator reported missing native GTK schemas and repaired environment. Later project-save and export pickers worked.
environment_observations.attribution: Known environment confound. Initial sampler Load sample action was not retried.

environment_observations.title: Native picker focus environment repair
environment_observations.observed: Coordinator later reported restoring clicked-window/root focus behavior. No clearly identified ignored typing was needed for this participant to recover.
environment_observations.attribution: Disclosed shared environment limitation, not an independent RILL issue.

successes: Empty-song screen makes instrument selection discoverable.
Included String Pad and Rubber Bass presets allowed two distinct instrument layers without downloads.
Pencil drag and automatic clip extension made drawing long sound shapes straightforward.
Context-menu loop playback selection set a visible, understandable loop range.
R1 Spacer has recognizable Echo, Reverb, Hall and Mix labels and a helpful visual decay shape.
File menu save/export entries and native file pickers supported completion within the session folder.
Export Loop range explicitly says exact length; completion banner names the output file.
unresolved_questions: Are any playable audio samples bundled with R1 Sampler, and where would a novice find them?
How does the exported music actually sound, including the effect tail at the loop boundary?
Is the first Effects popup vertical movement reproducible in ordinary human use, beyond screenshot timing?
Would an explicit initial Edit notes action make the empty pattern easier to understand?

saved_artifacts.kind: Continuous desktop/audio recording managed by coordinator

limitations: Simulated participant; findings are hypotheses about novice usability, not population statistics.
Audio could not be verified by listening during the session. No quality or audible-silence claim is made from meters or screenshots.
Native chooser and audio environment problems interrupted normal workflow.
Snapshot-based interaction can magnify transient dialog positioning; the recording should arbitrate S5-04.
No external plugins or sample downloads; no source changes or fixes.
